headline: Solana Long-Short Account Ratio Rises To 3.11 From 2.92 As The 30-Day Rank Hits 97.6
narrative: The Solana long-short account ratio rose to 3.11 from 2.92, and the 30-day rank rose to 97.6 from 91.1. The ratio counts long accounts against short accounts, and the rank is the share of hourly readings over the last 30 days below the current print, so the account mix is more long than on 97.6 percent of those hours, against a 30-day high of 3.2 and a low of 1.38. The ratio is up 0.19 on the day and 0.84 on the week, a crowded-long reading against Solana's own 30-day range.
author: jordan
